about_the_game:
You found an ancient ritual buried in a forgotten tome.
Seven circles. Seven spells. Seven witches — one for each day of the week. Each unique. Each starving.

These are no ordinary women.
They are sleeping goddesses of lust, former guardians of forbidden magic.
And there’s only one way to awaken them: through full physical and magical connection.

The ritual begins with the first. To open the next circle, you must fully satisfy the one before —
with penetration, domination, and by letting them drink every drop of power from your wand.
They feed on magic. You deliver it.

Each witch embodies a different form of desire: temptation, power, vengeance, ecstasy, submission, obsession…
and the final one, whose name was erased from history.

This is a ritual of sex, sorcery, and shadow — and it only ends when they’ve taken everything from you.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
